scope: New isolated keyless city-directory client and pure validators only; no shared Harness/provider/domain edits in this task.

interfaces.admission: before_call(safe_event) -> await positive finite remaining seconds; called only before an actual cache-miss wire request.
validators: validate_directory_candidate(value)->copied raw fact dict, not external provenance/consent
interfaces.error: PlaceDirectoryError(ValueError) with fixed code/message and validated numeric HTTP/retry facts only

invariants: Fixed HTTPS OpenMeteo search/get; trust_env=false, redirects=false, retries=0; no arbitrary URL or credentials.
City candidates use PPL* source records only; airports/AIRP and country/PCLI do not become cities.
No automatic first/capital/population choice; search returns candidates and explicit truncation.
Count1/full windows cannot be cached as proved unique; count is part of the key.
Stable source IDs/country/admin/finite coordinates/IANA timezone and row hash; no internal place_id/ref_version generated.
Streaming response capped at2MB; result records atrequested count<=5; request keys and source fields bounded.
All HTTP admission finishes before wire; total network timeout limited by both configured timeout and remaining seconds.
Cache hit costs0; positive/ambiguousTTL<=24h, negative<=900s; errors are not cached as no_match.
Bounded32inflight queries/128waiters; success/error shared; owner/waiter cancellation cleans map; no waiter retry.
External/SQL/callback error text and raw headers/body are not exported.

verification.pure_catalog_boundary: PASS: directory raw facts -> GeoCatalog._envelope -> _fact_snapshot; HTTP0/SQL0

prior_actual_contract_probe: docs/verification/openmeteo-geocoding-ar-20261027.json (two earlier authorized keyless reads; not executed through the new client)
limits: This does not wire global CityRef into messages/search/prices or qualify a global travel dialogue.
Raw fact/hash validation is structural and does not alone grant provenance or a user selection.
Catalog owns persisted identity IDs/versions and admission; domain/schema integration is separate.
The callback owner must reserve outside long SQL transactions and fence run state before applying returned facts.
